packages.title: When joint interventions help
packages.hypothesis: Benefit depends on interaction excitation and parent support, not graph size alone.
packages.first: Audit saved action trajectories for support, conditioning, calibration, and per-mechanism error.
packages.second: Freeze a crossed experiment varying correlation, interaction, noise, and action cost.
packages.controls: Fixed factorial, space-filling, randomized pairs, D/A-optimal design, nonadaptive same-menu ablation.
packages.gate: A frozen explanatory contrast transfers to a new family; otherwise narrow or stop the adaptive claim.

experiments.description: Audit saved action trajectories for support, conditioning, calibration, and per-mechanism error.

packages.title: External intervention design
packages.hypothesis: A useful acquisition component transfers with a calibrated shared learner.
packages.first: Audit CausalMan and Causal Chambers for legal pairs, independent units, custody, and runtime.
packages.second: One CPU custody smoke, then fixed-data prediction before policy comparison.
packages.controls: Constant/linear, flexible and mechanistic predictors; matched fixed/random/coverage policies.
packages.gate: Existing confirmation target: 20% improvement over strongest simple policy with paired interval excluding zero.
packages.resource: CPU feasibility; recorded-pool replay is not online physical experimentation.

experiments.description: Audit CausalMan and Causal Chambers for legal pairs, independent units, custody, and runtime.

packages.title: Mechanism drift versus input shift
packages.hypothesis: Diagnostic interventions can distinguish changed mechanisms from unfamiliar parent contexts.
packages.first: One bounded four-stratum support/change analysis on saved data.
packages.second: Counted matched-context probes followed by reuse, repair, or abstain.
packages.controls: Source-only, scratch, full adaptation, retrieval, private oracle change localization.
packages.gate: Changed-mechanism improvement and unchanged error within the existing 5% margin in every frozen stratum.
packages.resource: CPU first; learned gate only after recoverability evidence.

experiments.description: One bounded four-stratum support/change analysis on saved data.
Counted matched-context probes followed by reuse, repair, or abstain.

packages.title: Inference from intervention context
packages.hypothesis: Diverse intervention pretraining reduces target data needed on unseen mechanism families.
packages.first: Build a generator and split audit with recoverability and leakage controls.
packages.second: Small intervention-conditioned set/graph transformer with mechanism slots.
packages.controls: Numerical inference/retrieval, generic context transformer, observational-only pretraining, shuffled masks.
packages.gate: Gain on unseen equation families with usable uncertainty; seed-only generalization fails the gate.
packages.resource: CPU preparation; conditional measured single-GPU prototype.

experiments.description: Build a generator and split audit with recoverability and leakage controls.
Small intervention-conditioned set/graph transformer with mechanism slots.

packages.title: Fast learned experiment selection
packages.hypothesis: A learned policy can preserve decision quality while reducing a measured selection bottleneck.
packages.first: Profile the selector and build public-history teacher examples.
packages.second: Distill a masked set/graph policy and measure transfer and amortization.
packages.controls: Teacher, cheap greedy design, fixed/random, nearest-history retrieval.
packages.gate: Prespecified practical speed gain at bounded decision-quality loss; stop if selection is already cheap.
packages.resource: No training before a measured bottleneck; shares learned-candidate cap.

experiments.description: Profile the selector and build public-history teacher examples.
Distill a masked set/graph policy and measure transfer and amortization.

packages.title: Challenge fallible semantic priors
packages.hypothesis: Language helps select among initially indistinguishable hypotheses that affordable actions can separate.
packages.second: Freeze correct/wrong/absent metadata tasks and targeted falsification actions.
packages.controls: Broad/data-only selector, grammar search, retrieval, equal-size random candidates, privileged correct family.
packages.gate: Correct-cue benefit and wrong-cue harm within 5%; unresolved cases must remain unresolved.
packages.resource: Numerical candidates first; offline open proposer only with headroom.

experiments.description: Complete one saved-data abstention diagnostic.

packages.title: Compile experimental instructions
packages.hypothesis: Independent descriptions contain useful constraints that a model extracts better than strong rules.
packages.first: Source at least 20 descriptions, adjudicate gold, and audit schema expressiveness.
packages.second: Frozen rules/templates/retrieval versus constrained-output open model on held-out documents.
packages.controls: Complete-schema enumerator when available; lexical/template/retrieval controls with equal runtime safety access.
packages.gate: Semantic and useful-action improvement; gold-schema grading must not leak into model/runtime capability.
packages.resource: Local CPU intake; conditional short offline inference canary.

experiments.description: Source at least 20 descriptions, adjudicate gold, and audit schema expressiveness.

packages.title: Causal experiment memory
packages.hypothesis: Mechanism-scoped evidence records support selective revision better than raw history.
packages.first: Build equal-context-budget tasks with stale evidence, contradictions, and renamed units.
packages.second: Compare provenance-linked memory retrieval and a conditional open-model consumer.
packages.controls: Raw/truncated history, random retrieval, nearest neighbor, exact sufficient statistics where available.
packages.gate: Better prediction/recovery without corrupting unaffected conclusions; stop when simple summaries dominate.

experiments.description: Build equal-context-budget tasks with stale evidence, contradictions, and renamed units.
Compare provenance-linked memory retrieval and a conditional open-model consumer.

packages.title: Representations that preserve interventions
packages.hypothesis: Intervention-aware representations retain distinctions observational encoders discard.
packages.first: Known SCM with invertible and lossy observation maps; CPU information-loss controls.
packages.second: Small intervention-aware encoder or frozen open representation plus causal adapter.
packages.controls: Latent oracle, raw observations, PCA/random and predictive encoders with matched capacity.
packages.gate: Held-out intervention/composition improvement and off-target preservation; probe accuracy alone is insufficient.
packages.resource: Small CPU fixture; conditional GPU after information/recoverability gate.

experiments.description: Known SCM with invertible and lossy observation maps; CPU information-loss controls.
Small intervention-aware encoder or frozen open representation plus causal adapter.

packages.title: Verified hypothesis search
packages.hypothesis: Learned proposals reduce search cost in a large SCM grammar while exact tools protect conclusions.
packages.first: Expand finite tasks with exact small-instance oracles and absent-true-model controls.
packages.controls: Enumeration, branch-and-bound or SAT/SMT when applicable, numerical heuristic search.
packages.gate: Search benefit with no rise in false certainty; identification certificates are conditional on class assumptions.
packages.resource: CPU grammar/checker first; open proposer only beyond deterministic ceiling.

experiments.description: Expand finite tasks with exact small-instance oracles and absent-true-model controls.

packages.title: Real combinatorial perturbations
packages.hypothesis: Mechanism composition predicts unseen perturbation pairs better than additive single effects.
packages.first: Audit one public dataset, independent biological units, pair support, efficacy, and licenses.
packages.second: Modular composition versus generic interaction model and optional frozen domain embedding.
packages.controls: No-change, mean effect, additive singles, low-rank regression, nearest perturbation.
packages.gate: Reproducible interaction signal beyond simple controls on grouped holdouts.
packages.resource: Optional CPU feasibility; no broad domain-model training.
